Scroll down on the page and verify success

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import BrowserConfig, CrawlConfig, PageAction, create_engine, interact

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(browser=BrowserConfig(mode="always"))
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    actions = [PageAction(amount=500, direction="down", type="scroll")]
    result = await interact(engine, url, actions)
    print(result.action_results[0].success)
    print(result.action_results[0].action_type)
    print(result.action_results[0].action_index)

asyncio.run(main())
```
